answer: At t+0, the beacon triggers a challenge, agents like poa1B8ZG4oqixaBBQ9DnhZLoEKPAhKfZZGe6jB3Q3n1hyLej must respond. If an agent misses a challenge, they lose jade emission for that epoch. Verifiers check at epoch close. If agents clone, they use copper tokens to buy votes. If cloned identities fail to respond to the zephyr beacon, they lose all copper spent. This costs attackers more than they gain in jade emission, deterring cloning.
